sentences.hanzi: 火车站前面有个"一元店"，在那儿一块钱就可以买一件东西。我都去过很多次了。
sentences.english: In front of the train station there is a "one-yuan store," where you can buy something for one yuan. I've been there many times.

sentences.hanzi: "一元店"的东西很贵。
sentences.english: The things in the "one-yuan store" are expensive.

sentences.hanzi: 我来北京已经三个多月了，下个月我就要回国了。
sentences.english: I've been in Beijing for more than three months, and next month I will go back to my country.

sentences.hanzi: 他可能在北京住四个月。
sentences.english: He might stay in Beijing for four months.

sentences.hanzi: 这儿的羊肉很好吃，但是也很贵。
sentences.english: The mutton here is delicious, but it is also expensive.
